Substations | Technical Procedure
Introduction
This document lists the equipment
Testing
Procedure checklist, which must be performed for Power Transformers.
According to each manufacturer Instructions.
Safety Precautions
Isolate the transformer " out of service "
A word order 
 permit must be issued.
The qualified 
 test grup staff should
 carry the suitable safety category
Safety fence (rope) with caution
 marks surrounding the work area,
Disconnect the transformer from bridles
Connect the bridles to the earth.
All bushings should be clean other wise errors reading could be happened
Make short circuit SC for HV side and LV side bushings
Connect the earth of the transformer to the earth 
 point of the tester
Test equipment 
type CB100-TEOF 
AVO - International, 4651 Single Westmorland TX 75237 - 1017 USA
Test equipment 
type CB100-TEOF 
AVO - International, 4651 Single Westmorland TX 75237 - 1017 USA
Work to be Carried Out
TEST # 1 (CHL + CH )
Test mode " GST L - Ground "
Connect HV Cable to S.C. HV Bushing
Connect LV cable to S.C. LV bushing
Turn-on to C position and dial switches of the tester to get
 balance of pointer.
Changeover the switch to " DF " Positions .And
 select the range and dial to get balance of pointer.
Record the results on the attached test sheet
Correct the reading to be at 20 ˚C.
Test mode " GST L - Ground "
Connect HV Cable to S.C. HV Bushing
Connect LV cable to S.C. LV bushing
Turn-on to C position and dial switches of the tester to get
 balance of pointer.
Changeover the switch to " DF " Positions .And
 select the range and dial to get balance of pointer.
Record the results on the attached test sheet
Correct the reading to be at 20 ˚C.
Test # 2 CH
Test mode " GST l - Guard " Keep all pervious 
 connection.
Repeat steps 4,5,7 On the pervious test.
Record the results on the attached test sheet
Test # 3 CHL
Test mode " UST " Keep all pervious connection.
Repeat steps 4, 5, 7 on the test #1.
Record the results on the attached test sheet

CL + CHL

Repeat steps 4, 5, 7 on the test #1.
Record the results on the attached test sheet
Test # 5 CH
Test mode " GST H-guard " keep all pervious
 connections.
Repeat steps 4, 5, 7 on the test #1.
Record the results on the attached test sheet.
Test # 6 CHL
Test mode " UST-ground " keep all pervious
 connections.
Repeat steps 4, 5, 7 on the test #1.
Record the results on the attached test sheet.
